changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_resources (role_id, resource_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT DISTINCT r.id, res.id, NOW(), 'system' FROM (VALUES ('ADMIN','PURCHASE_POSITIONS'), ('MANAGER','PURCHASE_POSITIONS'), ('BUYER','PURCHASE_POSITIONS'), ('FOREMAN','PURCHASE_POSITIONS'), ('ADMIN','PURCHASE_REQUESTS'), ('MANAGER','PURCHASE_REQUESTS'), ('BUYER','PURCHASE_REQUESTS'), ('FOREMAN','PURCHASE_REQUESTS'), ('ADMIN','PROJECT_MATERIALS'), ('MANAGER','PROJECT_MATERIALS'), ('BUYER','PROJECT_MATERIALS'), ('FOREMAN','PROJECT_MATERIALS') ) g(role_code, res_code) JOIN roles r ON r.code = g.role_code JOIN resources res ON res.code = g.res_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resources x WHERE x.role_id = r.id AND x.resource_id = res.id );

INSERT INTO role_resource_operations (role_resource_id, operation_id) SELECT rr.id, o.id FROM (VALUES ('ADMIN','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','CREATE'), ('ADMIN','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','READ'), ('ADMIN','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','UPDATE'), ('ADMIN','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','DELETE'), ('MANAGER','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','CREATE'), ('MANAGER','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','READ'), ('MANAGER','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','UPDATE'), ('MANAGER','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','DELETE'), ('BUYER','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','CREATE'), ('BUYER','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','READ'), ('BUYER','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','UPDATE'), ('FOREMAN','PURCHASE_POSITIONS','READ'), ('ADMIN','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','CREATE'), ('ADMIN','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','READ'), ('ADMIN','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','UPDATE'), ('ADMIN','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','DELETE'), ('MANAGER','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','CREATE'), ('MANAGER','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','READ'), ('MANAGER','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','UPDATE'), ('MANAGER','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','DELETE'), ('BUYER','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','READ'), ('BUYER','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','UPDATE'), ('FOREMAN','PURCHASE_REQUESTS','READ'), ('ADMIN','PROJECT_MATERIALS','CREATE'), ('ADMIN','PROJECT_MATERIALS','READ'), ('ADMIN','PROJECT_MATERIALS','UPDATE'), ('ADMIN','PROJECT_MATERIALS','DELETE'), ('MANAGER','PROJECT_MATERIALS','CREATE'), ('MANAGER','PROJECT_MATERIALS','READ'), ('MANAGER','PROJECT_MATERIALS','UPDATE'), ('MANAGER','PROJECT_MATERIALS','DELETE'), ('BUYER','PROJECT_MATERIALS','CREATE'), ('BUYER','PROJECT_MATERIALS','READ'), ('BUYER','PROJECT_MATERIALS','UPDATE'), ('BUYER','PROJECT_MATERIALS','DELETE'), ('FOREMAN','PROJECT_MATERIALS','READ') ) g(role_code, res_code, op_code) JOIN roles r ON r.code = g.role_code JOIN resources res ON res.code = g.res_code JOIN role_resources rr ON rr.role_id = r.id AND rr.resource_id = res.id JOIN operations o ON o.code = g.op_code WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_resource_operations x WHERE x.role_resource_id = rr.id AND x.operation_id = o.id );
